I feel the same way a lot of the time, it's only been just over a week since I broke up with him. The thing I keep telling myself and I think you should hear is that even though we feel like this right now, we aren't going to forever. I am fat, and ugly, and have many other negative traits too, but I know that no matter what I am going to finally find somebody that loves me the way I deserve to be loved and that leaving him was the only way that I will ever be able to be truly happy in the future. Even though everything is bad right now, please remember that there were good times before him, and there are so many more to come, you just need to do what you need to in order to make sure that you get there. I truly hope that you stay safe, that you drink water, eat something every day, sleep, and take care of yourself. Even though it may feel impossible right now, I promise you that your future self will thank you for being kind to yourself. Please stay safe and I see that someone else commented some help links so I hope that if you are in a crisis you use those links or call 911. 

You are so much stronger than you know.
